title: cerastium alpinum f. lanatum
intro: Cerastium alpinum f. lanatum, commonly known as Woolly Snow-in-Summer, is a flowering plant species in the carnation family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium alpinum f. lanatum include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
